metadata.case_name: LAI HO CHUEN (A MINOR) v. HUNG LING YUNG

injuries.description: 4-cm wound to his right lower leg with bone exposure
source: Lai sustained a 4-cm wound to his right lower leg with bone exposure.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

injuries.description: The distal shaft of the leg was fractured and displaced
source: The distal shaft of the leg was fractured and displaced.

injuries.description: Scars at the skin graft donor site of the inner thigh, near the knee and the lower leg
injuries.body_part: inner thigh; near the knee and the lower leg
source: There are scars at the skin graft donor site of the inner thigh, near the knee and the lower leg.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of hip or thigh

injuries.description: Insignificant length discrepancy (0.5-1cm) between his legs
source: There was no residual symptom apart from the insignificant length discrepancy (0.5-1cm) between his legs.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: pain upon the accident and from the subsequent operations
Post-traumatic syndrome (PTS) diagnosed by Dr Li (reduced by 2007)
Lai was then observed to be disruptive at school
Lai no longer complained about the scars, apart from feeling embarrassed

treatments_received: pressure garment (short pant) worn to control the scar on the skin donor site of the inner thigh until the end of 2004

losses.description: Embarrassment and noticeable but pale scars at donor site and leg
Minor psychological impact including prior post-traumatic syndrome, low self-esteem and need for psychological therapy/family counselling
